summary: Iteration-9 review: Cashfree LIVE production PG integration + embedded top-up modal + public /track RFD- branch. 16/17 backend pytest passed, 1 skipped (admin-orders status patch endpoint not present in this build — test correctly skips). All Cashfree endpoints verified end-to-end with LIVE production keys: GET /payments/cashfree/config returns {configured:true, mode:'production'}; POST /me/wallet/topup/cashfree creates a real Cashfree order, persists db.cashfree_orders row, returns valid WTU-* order_id + payment_session_id; unauthenticated→401; status endpoint reconciles unknown→502; webhook signature validation rejects missing/invalid sig→401; pay-with-order endpoint enforces price/owner/already-paid guards. Order creation works; only the JS-SDK redirect view rejects the preview domain. Mobile (390×844) no horizontal overflow on /track, /me/wallet, /tools. /payments/return renders with status icon + OPEN MY WALLET link and gracefully handles unknown order_id (shows polling 'Confirming your payment…'). /track placeholder mentions ORD-/REC-/RFD- and real RFD-958B2C3904 renders [refund-track-card] with the Recovery/Order-matching panel chrome (refund-trace-timeline shown for in-progress; rejected refunds show 'Refund Rejected' state card instead — design-intent, not a bug).

critical_code_review_comments: cashfree_service._request uses x-idempotency-key=uuid4() per request — this defeats idempotency on retries. For create_order, the idempotency key should be deterministic (e.g. the WTU-* / OPY-* order_id) so a retried create from the same browser tab doesn't create two CF orders. Today, a network glitch + retry could double-create.

cashfree_webhook returns {ok:true} even when signature validation passes but order_id is missing or reconcile fails — Cashfree's webhook delivery treats anything other than 2xx as 'redeliver'; returning 200 on logical failure silently drops events. Consider returning 202 + logging the bad payload.
Frontend CashfreeTopupModal: no debounce / disabled-state on [cashfree-pay-btn] during the POST — double-click could fire two top-up orders. Add a `submitting` state guard.

MyWallet.jsx wallet-cashfree-cta panel is the new prominent CTA at the top of ADD BALANCE — design tone matches the Tools section aesthetic the user praised (green-glow + eh-panel + bracket). Mobile stacks cleanly.
/payments/return polls but I didn't observe the polling interval cap — for a long-pending order (CF takes minutes), ensure it stops at N attempts to avoid open sockets.

(6) The Cashfree webhook signature is base64(HMAC_SHA256(secret, ts+rawBody)) — verified by cashfree_service.verify_webhook_signature.
rca_of_the_issue: No backend code bug. The only observable failure — Cashfree hosted checkout 'Broken Link! domain not approved' — is purely a merchant-side allowlist step at https://merchant.cashfree.com/developers. Our /api/me/wallet/topup/cashfree returned 200 with a valid payment_session_id, proving the LIVE production keys and the create-order signature are working correctly. Once the user whitelists the deployed domain(s), the existing code will complete the full PG flow end-to-end.
